notes.title: 1.10 Freestyle game mode
notes.content:
Version 1.10 is here. 

We have added a new game mode called Freestyle. There are no mistakes in Freestyle, you can fiddle with the colors as much as you want until they perfectly match the numbers. All powerups are disabled in this game mode.

Have fun!

notes.title: Added Language support for German, French and Czech.
notes.content: Right click on the app title in your steam library, go to properties -> language and select your desired language from the drop down menu. Have fun!
